notes.title: In Silence - Winterland Update
notes.notes:
Hello to everyone,

First of all, we hope you are in good health during the pandemic period. We are very happy to announce the contents of our new update to you. 

* New Map: Winterland
* New Modes: Chase, Brutal Monster, Hunt
* New Lobby Types: Private, Public
* New Male Character
* New Outfits for Winterland
* New Escape Mechanic
* New 5 Achievements
* New Item: Metal Scrap
* Keybindings
* Better Optimization
* Better Cheat Protection
* Better AI 
* Vote Kicking System
* Sliding on frozen grounds

and much more...

Now go and hunt your friends on Winterland!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38270656/d8df80c099f599d71f32a0c2b149824b5f67d10e.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Winterland Trailer Release Date
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

We hope everyone is in good health during the pandemic period. Because of this process, we were also affected by the development of In Silence.
We are as sorry as you are for this situation. We experienced the difficulties of developing the project with 2 people in this process.

We have been working on the Winterland map for a long time and the feedback we received from you. We have prepared our new trailer, worked on 3 new modes, escape mechanic, key bindings, optimization, cheat protection etc... and plan to release In Silence as full version on Halloween

Winterland Trailer will be released on [b]September 29[/b].

notes.title: Patch Notes v0.60
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

Now you can change push to talk key. On next updates, we gonna add keybinding system.

We tried to add new solutions for stuck on loading screen. Maybe this update will work on your computers.
Now you cannot see who is talking in game.
Codes' positions changed
A few spelling error fixed
Repairing, Item pick up-drop, trap sound volumes decreased
A few little bugs fixed

Don't forget to update your game. If your game version is not same with your friends, you cannot join same lobby.

Thanks
Stay Healthy

notes.title: Patch Notes v0.50
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, 

* Removed Halloween event but fireworks will continue to stay in the game. 
* Better graphical optimization

Stay Healthy

notes.title: Halloween Update
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, we were working on Halloween update and added a few new mechanics. You should check it :)

* Firework and mini-missile items added.
* Witch added.
* New character skins added.
* New Halloween atmosphere.
* New rat skin.
* A few little bugs fixed.
* Rake's blur amount decreased.
* New flashbang effect added.
* Localization bugs fixed.

Happy Halloween
Stay Healthy

notes.title: Patch Notes v0.40
notes.notes:
Patch Notes v0.40

We are listening to you and trying to improve gameplay. We hope you will like the new mechanics.

* If the player count is more than 3, one of the survivors will be a "Guide" and lead the other survivors. "Guide" has a map system like rat
* You don't need to click mouse buttons to rotate the truck camera.
* When the Rake is stunned by a flashbang, it will not be able to see the radar for a few seconds.
* Some environment collision bugs have been fixed.
* Car repair time has been increased by 2 to 3 seconds.
* You now have 3 wrong code chances for the armory.
* Rake's body block has been removed.
* Survivors getting body blocked by the Rake has been removed.
* Rake will not get stuck on items. (battery, fuel can etc...)
* Rake's blur effect has been increased.
* Rematch button is now automatically active.
* New storm ambient sound added

notes.title: Patch Notes v0.32
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

On this update, we changed the atmosphere of the map, added some information for newbie players and fixed a few bugs.

* New cold and windy atmosphere
* Decreased the blur effect of Rake
* New ambiance and sound effects.
* Timer warnings added.
* Tension sound effect added.
* While crouching and when you press the [Shift] key,  you get up from and start running
* 00:30 seconds timer bug fixed.

We really want to hear your ideas about atmosphere guys. 

Thank you
Stay healthy

notes.title: Patch Notes v0.3
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

We fixed a lot of things, changed some mechanics and added new options to game settings for better gameplay. 

* Now survivors start next to the car.
* You can change blindness level of Rake (Check the game settings on lobby)
* Rake's running speed decreased
* Survivors walk more slowly when crouching
* Rake's camera effects changed. It is more clear now.
* The car's headlights are on now.
* New survivor movement speed settings added:1, 1.1x, 1.2x, 1.3x, 1.4x, 1.5x
* New time limit settings added: 15-20-25-30 minutes or No Limit 
* Crouching bug fixed.
* Spinning bug fixed.
* Toy & Jack in the box sound effects fixed.
